title: Basis profile curve identification to understand electrical stimulation effects in human brain networks
description: This dataset contains intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from one patient undergoing single pulse electrical stimulation at the Mayo Clinic. It was collected to study the effects of electrical stimulation on human brain networks, and it supports a larger effort to build a database of single pulse stimulation data for understanding the human connectome across the lifespan. The data accompany a paper on basis profile curve identification.
methods_description: The patient rested in a hospital bed while single pulse electrical stimulation was delivered at about 0.2 Hz. Pulses were biphasic, 200 microseconds long, and 6 mA in amplitude. Amplitude was sometimes reduced to 1 or 2 mA over motor cortex to minimize movement artifacts.
